Description: Full path to the daily Axonius user export CSV on the root server. Operator sets this in 07-05. Empty until then.
Stale-file guard for the Axonius export. If the export is older than this many days the ingest WARNS and continues (D-05) - it does not abort.
OVERRIDE only. Empty means derive from the wwwRootFolder registry value + \Uploads\CustomRepository\SoftwarePortal\roleref (RESEARCH A10). Set a value here only to write snapshots somewhere else.
Base URL the per-region policy action prefetches roleref-<region>-latest.json from. Matches the Dispatcher rewritePrefetchUrls() target subtree.
BigFix REST API base URL used by root-server scripts (fixlet PUT, /api/query).
Path to Cyera's universal-identity vault token. RoleSync READS this file only - Cyera's rotator is the sole writer (D-20). Not a secret; a path.
AKeyless secret path for the BigFix operator password. This is a PATH, not a secret value. Operator confirms/creates the secret in 07-05 (RESEARCH A4).
Username of the BigFix operator service account whose password lives at AKeylessSecretPath. Operator sets this in 07-05.
How far forward a reconciled endpoint Map row's Valid_to is pushed. Mirrors Initialize-RoleDb.ps1 -ValidityMonths and PORTAL_CONFIG.validityMonths.
Coalesce order for the username match key (D-06): sAMAccountName, then UPN local-part, then Aggregated: User Name. Recorded per user as RefUser.Username_Src.
Directory on the root server containing sqlite3.exe directly (no arch subfolder). Pinned version 3.53.1, zip sha1 184d4d0b75cd75c2118fb22a1727e9220f843b98.
Optional webhook URL for pipeline failure alerts. Empty = alerting off.
The client-relevance expression the per-region policy action substitutes to identify the console user (RESEARCH Pitfall 2). 07-05 can switch this to 'names of logged on users' with no code edit.
